component.name: Intel OpenCL driver (legacy platforms)
component.summary: Intel OpenCL driver for Gen8, Gen9 and Gen11 graphics

description.p: This is an unofficial extension containing the Intel OpenCL driver built from the compute-runtime legacy line. It supports Broadwell, Skylake, Kaby Lake, Coffee Lake, Apollo Lake, Gemini Lake, Ice Lake and Elkhart Lake graphics, which are no longer supported by the current driver.

It can be installed next to org.freedesktop.Platform.GL.OpenCLIntel: both drivers use different library names and register separate OpenCL platforms, so a machine with both a legacy and a current Intel GPU can load them at the same time.
